questions.question: Explain why a market tends to move towards its equilibrium price when the price is initially below it. (4 marks)
Analyse the effect on the equilibrium price and quantity of rice of a poor harvest combined with rising incomes among consumers. (6 marks)
Draw a demand and supply diagram showing consumer surplus and producer surplus at the market equilibrium. (4 marks)

A specific tax of $3 per unit raises the price buyers pay from $10 to $12 and reduces the quantity traded from 600 to 500 units. Calculate the consumer incidence of the tax and the revenue the government collects. (4 marks)
Draw a demand and supply diagram to show the effect of a specific subsidy of $3 per unit on the price paid by consumers and the price received by producers. (4 marks)
Examine the effects of a subsidy on cooking fuel on consumers, producers and the government. (8 marks)
Discuss how effectively the price mechanism allocates resources in local, national and global markets. (14 marks)
Evaluate the view that changes in supply, rather than changes in demand, are the main cause of changes in the price of agricultural commodities. (20 marks)
